title: Nosey skills map (schemaVersion 1 and 2)
description: Structural contract for skills-map.json. The instance schemaVersion discriminates versions 1 and 2; this schema document has a single revision. This schema is not a registry validator: parser-only rules (uniqueness by property, regex compilation, UTF-16 source limits, external source shape, path normalization) and registry-level integration rules (registryId agreement, skill file existence, dangling references, external identity conflicts) are listed instead of encoded.

$schema.title: Editor annotation
$schema.description: Conventional editor annotation only. Nosey ignores it, registry writers preserve it verbatim, and it is unconstrained here: a non-string value is accepted too.

schemaVersion.title: Schema version
schemaVersion.description: Map format version: 1 for local skills only, 2 when externalSkills may appear.

registryId.title: Registry ID
registryId.description: Identity shared with registry.json and skills-manifest.json. The owner/repository shape is an initializer authoring rule, not a parser rule.
registryId.x-normalization: Rewritten by registry init, which remaps this prefix in local skill references.

alwaysRecommend.title: Always-recommended skills
alwaysRecommend.description: Skill IDs recommended in every project. Absent means an empty list; null is rejected.

externalSkills.title: External skill declarations
externalSkills.description: Installable skills hosted outside this registry. schemaVersion 2 only: in version 1 any presence, including null and [], is rejected by the parser.
externalSkills.x-normalization: In schemaVersion 2, missing or null normalizes to []; in schemaVersion 1 the property must be absent.

technologies.title: Technology declarations
technologies.description: Extra technologies with detection rules. Missing or null normalizes to []; any other non-array value is rejected.

technologySkills.title: Technology recommendations
technologySkills.description: Skill recommendations per technology ID. Absent means an empty list; null is rejected.

combinations.title: Combination declarations
combinations.description: Skill combinations that require several technologies. Missing or null normalizes to []; any other non-array value is rejected.

combinationSkills.title: Combination recommendations
combinationSkills.description: Skill recommendations per combination ID. Absent means an empty list; null is rejected.

frontendBonusSkills.title: Frontend bonus skills
frontendBonusSkills.description: Skills recommended for detected web frontends. Absent means an empty list; null is rejected.

frontendPackages.title: Frontend packages
frontendPackages.description: Packages that mark a project as a web frontend. Absent means an empty list; null is rejected.

webFrontendExtensions.title: Frontend file extensions
webFrontendExtensions.description: File extensions that mark a project as a web frontend. Absent means an empty list; null is rejected.

then.title: schemaVersion 1 forbids externalSkills
then.description: In version 1 any presence of externalSkills, including null and [], is rejected, so the property name itself is forbidden.

Text.title: Nonblank string
Text.description: The parser's text() rule: a string containing at least one non-whitespace character. Empty strings, whitespace-only strings, and non-strings are rejected. The pattern matches exactly the characters trim() removes, including U+00A0, U+1680, U+2028, U+202F, and U+FEFF.

NonEmptyArrayItem.title: Nonempty array element
NonEmptyArrayItem.description: The parser's strings() rule for reference arrays: every element is a string of at least one character. Unlike text(), whitespace-only elements pass. Duplicates are accepted here.

LocalSkillId.title: Local skill ID
LocalSkillId.description: A locally declared skill ID is <registryId>/<relative directory under skills>, for example acme/skills/group/example. Nested folders are supported, so no segment count is enforced; the external three-segment ID rule does not apply.
LocalSkillId.x-normalization: Generated as <registryId>/<relative directory under skills>; init remaps the registryId prefix and leaves external IDs untouched.

StringList.title: String array
StringList.description: The parser's strings() rule: an array of strings of at least one character each. Whitespace-only elements pass and duplicates are accepted; no reference array is unique.

JsonRegex.title: JSON regular expression
JsonRegex.description: A regular expression serialized as {source, flags}. Unknown keys are ignored by the parser. Compilation is a parser-only rule: duplicate flags, u together with v, unsupported flags, and invalid expressions are rejected there.

source.title: Pattern source
source.description: The pattern body. An empty string is accepted. The parser bounds this at 512 UTF-16 code units while maxLength counts code points, so a long astral pattern can pass here and fail the parser.

flags.title: Pattern flags
flags.description: Optional flag string. g and y are rejected because detection must be deterministic; x is not a Node flag.

ContentBlock.title: Config file content block
ContentBlock.description: A matching rule over configuration file contents. Unknown keys are ignored by the parser.

patterns.title: Content patterns
patterns.description: Between 1 and 64 entries. A string entry is accepted unconstrained, including the empty string, because strings() is not applied to it.

anyOf.title: Literal pattern
anyOf.description: A literal or unparsed pattern string. Empty strings pass here.

files.title: Config file names
files.description: Optional file names this block applies to.

sourceExtensions.title: Source extensions
sourceExtensions.description: Optional source extensions this block applies to.

stripComments.title: Comment stripping
stripComments.description: Optional comment syntax to strip before matching.

DetectConfig.title: Detection config
DetectConfig.description: How a technology is detected. Unknown keys are rejected here, unlike every other object in this document.

packagePatterns.title: Package patterns
packagePatterns.description: Regular expressions matched against package names.

configFileContent.title: Config file content rules
configFileContent.description: One content block or an array of content blocks, including an empty array.

Technology.title: Technology
Technology.description: A declared technology. Unknown keys are ignored by the parser.

id.title: Technology ID
id.description: Unique among declared technologies; duplicates are rejected by the parser only.

skills.title: Recommended skills
skills.description: Optional. Absent means an empty list; null is rejected.

Combination.title: Combination
Combination.description: A declared skill combination. Unknown keys are ignored by the parser.

id.title: Combination ID
id.description: Unique among declared combinations; duplicates are rejected by the parser only.

requires.title: Required technology IDs
requires.description: Required. An empty array is accepted.

skills.title: Recommended skills
skills.description: Optional. Absent means an empty list; null is rejected.

TechnologySkills.title: Technology recommendations
TechnologySkills.description: Skills recommended when a technology is detected. Unknown keys are ignored by the parser.

technologyId.title: Technology ID
technologyId.description: Unique among technology recommendations; duplicates are rejected by the parser only.

CombinationSkills.title: Combination recommendations
CombinationSkills.description: Skills recommended when a combination matches. Unknown keys are ignored by the parser.

combinationId.title: Combination ID
combinationId.description: Unique among combination recommendations; duplicates are rejected by the parser only.

ExternalSkill.title: External skill
ExternalSkill.description: A skill hosted outside this registry. Unknown keys are rejected here, unlike other records.

id.title: External skill ID
id.description: Exactly three segments of [A-Za-z0-9_.@-], and no segment may be a single or double dot. Unique among external skills; duplicates are rejected by the parser only.

source.title: Upstream source
source.description: GitHub owner/repository, https://github.com/owner/repo, or git@github.com:owner/repo, with optional .git and trailing slash. The shape and its case-insensitive canonical form are parser-only rules.
source.x-normalization: Compared case-insensitively as owner/repo across registries.

skill.title: Upstream skill name
skill.description: A single segment of [A-Za-z0-9_.@-] that is not a single or double dot.

description.title: External skill description
description.description: Optional. When present it must pass text(), so null and whitespace-only values are rejected.
